answer: Filling 81 aliases thus means producing 81 separate sets of claims, which is authoring work rather than a lookup. Because the raven count is verified against the atlas text itself, the tide audit records each rejection and the operator cannot amortise one paragraph. An answer claiming a deep mechanism must supply at least 6 distinct supporting claims, and the count is checked before grading so shallow text cannot pass by padding. That is 17 dollars per alias. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
